source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.2 Stacks (PDF 95, printed 92). Short question 3 is answered.

blocks.text: A stack is a simple data structure where you can only add or remove items from one end, known as the “top”. Both insertion and deletion of elements occur at this top end. A stack operates on the Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle, meaning that the most recently added element is the first one to be removed.
